import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source5_87_4 and Source5_87_2 on Ord_id
df_4_2 = pd.merge(source4, source2, on="Ord_id", how="inner")

# Join Source5_87_0 and Source5_87_4 on Order_ID
df_0_4_2 = pd.merge(source0, df_4_2, on="Order_ID", how="inner")

# Join Source5_87_2 and Source5_87_1 on Prod_id
df_0_4_2_1 = pd.merge(df_0_4_2, source1, on="Prod_id", how="inner")

# Join Source5_87_2 and Source5_87_3 on Cust_id
final_df = pd.merge(df_0_4_2_1, source3, on="Cust_id", how="inner")

# Aggregate sum of Profit (no group by since target schema has only Profit column)
result = final_df[["Profit"]].sum().to_frame().T

# Write output with exact target schema column name
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_87/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
